modules.title: Introduction to Islamic Economics
modules.html:
Zakat and Sadaqah, the prohibition of riba (interest), and lawful trade and earning. This section covers introduction to islamic economics.

Key points

  • In Islamic Inheritance (Mirath), a daughter's share when she is the only child is _____. — One-half.
  • The Islamic concept of 'Ihsan' means _____. — to worship Allah as if you see Him.
  • The 'Kharaj' in Islamic taxation refers to _____. — land tax.
  • The Islamic ruling on 'Riba' (Usury/Interest) is that it is... — Haram.

Worked examples

Q: In Islamic Inheritance (Mirath), a daughter's share when she is the only child is _____.
A: One-half — According to the Qur'an (Surat an-Nisa), if there is only one daughter and no son, she receives half of the estate.

Q: The Islamic concept of 'Ihsan' means _____.
A: to worship Allah as if you see Him — In the Hadith of Jibril, Ihsan is defined as 'to worship Allah as if you see Him, and if you cannot see Him, you know He sees you'.

examples.q: In Islamic Inheritance (Mirath), a daughter's share when she is the only child is _____.

examples.a: to worship Allah as if you see Him

quiz.q: In Islamic Inheritance (Mirath), a daughter's share when she is the only child is _____.
quiz.solution: According to the Qur'an (Surat an-Nisa), if there is only one daughter and no son, she receives half of the estate.

quiz.q: The Islamic concept of 'Ihsan' means _____.
options: to worship Allah as if you see Him
quiz.solution: In the Hadith of Jibril, Ihsan is defined as 'to worship Allah as if you see Him, and if you cannot see Him, you know He sees you'.

quiz.q: The 'Kharaj' in Islamic taxation refers to _____.
quiz.solution: Kharaj is a tax on agricultural land, typically applied to lands conquered by Muslims.

quiz.q: The Islamic ruling on 'Riba' (Usury/Interest) is that it is...
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Haram.

quiz.q: The battle in which the Muslims suffered a setback due to the disobedience of the archers was the Battle of _____.
quiz.solution: At Uhud, the archers left their positions on the hill against the Prophet's orders, allowing Khalid b. Walid to lead a counter-attack.

quiz.q: The Surah that protects a person from the trials of the Dajjal (Anti-Christ) if the first ten verses are memorized is _____.
quiz.solution: Prophet Muhammad (SAW) recommended reciting Surat al-Kahf on Fridays and memorizing its opening for protection against the Dajjal.

quiz.q: The 'Night of Power' (Laylatul-Qadr) is better than _____ months.
quiz.solution: Surat al-Qadr states that worship on this night in Ramadan is better than a thousand months of worship.

quiz.q: The term 'Sadaqah' generally refers to _____.
quiz.solution: While Zakat is obligatory, Sadaqah refers to any act of voluntary kindness or financial help given for the sake of Allah.

quiz.q: The main focus of Surat al-Ma'un is _____.
quiz.solution: The Surah criticizes those who pray for show but refuse to help the orphans and the poor.

quiz.q: The five daily prayers are: Fajr, Zuhr, Asr, Maghrib, and _____.
quiz.solution: Isha is the night prayer, the last of the five obligatory daily prayers.

quiz.q: Which of the following is the 'Prophet of Allah' who was swallowed by a whale?
quiz.solution: Prophet Yunus (AS) was swallowed by a whale and remained in its belly until he was released through prayer and repentance.

quiz.q: The 'Qiblatayn' Mosque is significant because _____.
options: it is where the Prophet died
it is where the prayer direction changed
it is the first mosque built
quiz.solution: Masjid al-Qiblatayn (Mosque of the Two Qiblahs) is where the revelation came to change the prayer direction from Jerusalem to Makkah.
